probes: SELECT c.capability_key, c.kind, c.display_name, string_agg(pc.plan_key || '=' || pc.value::text, ',' ORDER BY pc.plan_key) AS plans FROM edge_bff.capabilities c LEFT JOIN edge_bff.plan_capabilities pc USING (capability_key) WHERE c.capability_key = 'support.send' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT p.plan_key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edge_bff.plan_capabilities pc WHERE pc.plan_key = p.plan_key AND pc.capability_key = 'support.send') AS holds FROM edge_bff.plans p WHERE p.for_guests ORDER BY 1

SELECT table_name, string_agg(column_name || ':' || data_type || ':' || is_nullable, ', ' ORDER BY ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'edge_bff' AND table_name IN ('support_tickets', 'support_attachments') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT conrelid::regclass::text AS tbl, conname, contype FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid IN ('edge_bff.support_tickets'::regclass, 'edge_bff.support_attachments'::regclass) ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT tablename, indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'edge_bff' AND tablename IN ('support_tickets', 'support_attachments') ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT e.t AS table_name, e.p AS expected, string_agg(x.priv, ',' ORDER BY x.priv) FILTER (WHERE has_table_privilege('edge_bff_runtime', 'edge_bff.' || e.t, x.priv)) AS held FROM (VALUES ('support_tickets', 'DELETE,INSERT,SELECT,UPDATE'), ('support_attachments', 'DELETE,INSERT,SELECT')) AS e(t, p) CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER']) AS x(priv) GROUP BY e.t, e.p ORDER BY e.t

SELECT t, has_table_privilege('public', 'edge_bff.' || t, 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') AS any FROM unnest(ARRAY['support_tickets', 'support_attachments']) AS t ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.relname, a.attname, x.privilege_type FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(a.attacl) x WHERE a.attacl IS NOT NULL AND c.oid IN ('edge_bff.support_tickets'::regclass, 'edge_bff.support_attachments'::regclass) ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.support_tickets) AS tickets, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.support_attachments) AS images

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.support_tickets) AS tickets, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.support_attachments) AS images, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.user_capability_overrides WHERE capability_key = 'support.send') AS overrides
